codeReview.summary: Clean, well-scoped fix that addresses both items from the scrutiny findings. The dead code removal (progressStore, getProgress, setProgress, StoredProgress) is complete — no references remain in the codebase. The PUT progress handler was simplified correctly: the redundant setProgress() call was removed while the in-memory review mutation (the actual source of truth) was preserved. The readback assertions added to both PUT progress tests are meaningful — they verify actual pillar data (progress, answeredQuestions, totalQuestions) on the review object, not just the response shape. The comment was updated from 'Also update the review's pillar progress in-memory for immediate consistency' to 'Update the review's pillar progress in-memory', correctly reflecting that this is now the sole persistence path rather than a secondary consistency mechanism.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The backend-worker skill procedure requires manual curl verification (step 6: 'Manual Verification' with interactiveChecks), but the worker skipped this step entirely — the handoff contains no interactiveChecks field. For a pure dead-code-removal + test-enhancement fix this is justified (no new endpoints or changed behavior to curl-test), but the skill procedure doesn't distinguish between 'new endpoint' work and 'refactor/cleanup' work. The skill could note that manual curl checks can be skipped for pure refactoring/dead-code-removal features that don't change API behavior.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff JSON has no interactiveChecks field. Skill SKILL.md step 6 says 'Each manual check = one interactiveChecks entry'. skillFeedback.followedProcedure is true despite this omission.
